subject: loss of centroided information after mzBin

messages.author: db2a70d9b31cb1f7
messages.subject: loss of centroided information after mzBin
parts:
Hi Kylie,

it would be great if the centroided information could be kept during mzBin.

Also in version 2.5 centroided = NA after mzBin.
Not a big deal to set it to back to TRUE or FALSE to make e.g. combining of files possible, but would be easier if the information would be kept automatically.

Thanks,
Melanie

messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Re: loss of centroided information after mzBin
parts:
This is currently intentional, as mzBin() modifies the spectra in such a way that does not preserve the m/z values.

But I could be convinced that it would make more sense to propagate the original value of centroided() though. Thoughts?

-Kylie

messages.author: db2a70d9b31cb1f7
messages.subject: Re: loss of centroided information after mzBin
parts:
Hi Kylie,

in all my use cases I would like to keep the centroided information. At least in previous Cardinal versions it was also a requirement for combining files and this is the main application I use mzBin for.

The only use case that comes to my mind in which centroided would need to change is when large bins are applied to centroid the data. This is a very special use case and if this is applied people will be aware that they have to adjust the centroided information.

Hopefully there are more thoughts coming...

Best,
Melanie
